scripts.lint: eslint . && node --import tsx cli/src/bin.ts check --root . --rules no-comments
scripts.spec:lint: node --import tsx cli/src/bin.ts spec lint spec
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm spec:lint && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e

CHEF_PASSWORD.description: The password you sign in to chef with. Scripts send it as a Bearer token. Use at least 8 characters; a long random one is best, for example from `openssl rand -base64 24`.
